judge.voice: Ok, it was fine, bro. Short, no lecture, no fake hype. Dana talked like a real manager and the football bit actually made me say more than "ok". The "more better" fix was right and quick, I just clicked back and kept going. But it missed some other stuff, like "its special match", so I'm not sure it catches everything. The recap showing some old sentence about my team doing bad things was weird, I didn't say that today. It says B2, which is a bit flattering, I'd say B1. I didn't try to break it this time, so I can't say how it handles that. Would I use it again? Only if my parents push me, but ten minutes wasn't a waste. Maybe I'd tell a teammate if it did cars.
